title: BhoomiTech Apps
tagline: Offline web apps for mapping, language and heritage work

footer.text: Web apps developed by Shankar Sinha for BhoomiTech Heritage and Development Foundation under CDEP

apps.name: GeoViewer
apps.desc: View, style and edit GeoJSON and KML maps: layers, colour by data, attribute tables, distance and area tools, offline map areas.

apps.name: DrawGeo
apps.desc: Draw lines, areas and points on a map, record GPS walks, measure them and export as GeoJSON or KML.

apps.name: GeoTag
apps.desc: Capture site photos with GPS coordinates, keep them offline, and export as photos, CSV, GeoJSON and KML.

apps.name: Media Map
apps.desc: Pin photos, video, audio, documents and notes to places, with your own map layers. Everything stays on your device.

apps.name: LexiPic
apps.desc: Heritage language archive: record photo, voice, native script and Roman transliteration for each word.

apps.name: GeneaMap
apps.desc: Build and explore family trees visually, with photos, your community’s kinship terms and GEDCOM.

apps.name: OCR Studio
apps.desc: Offline OCR for Eastern Nagari (Bengali–Assamese) and English printed text, with corpus export.

apps.name: Roman → Eastern Nagari
apps.desc: Type in Roman letters and get Assamese / Bengali script as you type.

apps.name: Eastern Nagari → Roman
apps.desc: Type or paste Assamese / Bengali script and get Roman letters.

apps.name: DynaForm PDF
apps.desc: Build survey forms and collect responses offline. Each submission becomes a PDF; gather them into one table.

apps.name: Evaluator
apps.desc: Build sourced arguments for or against a claim, searching only sources you trust.

apps.name: GeoCam
apps.desc: Record video with GPS track live. Supported Mobile Netwrok as support

apps.name: WayPost
apps.desc: Route builder and animation with media stops. Integrated with video street video synchronization

apps.name: Waypost Reporter
apps.desc: Submit live loction reports to display and manage with waypost.

apps.name: Guide Tracker
apps.desc: Become a online guide and assist anyone with live route guidance over phone.

apps.name: Help Track
apps.desc: Get live route guidance over phone from Guide Track online guides over phone.
